text:
sam: FYI saw a perf regression on the seq32 small-batch path this morning. kernel-chooser picked Triton but Cutlass was >10% faster after KV cache warmed.

devon: numbers? can you paste the perf snippet and repro?

sam: pasted below — this is from a focused run on h100, model=v2-small, seq=32, kv-warm means 95% hit. note how Triton has lower cold latency but worse steady throughput.

```
config: model=v2-small seq=32
batch sizes: 1,2,4,8
KV: cold vs warm (0% vs 95% hit)

Triton  (cold): p50=18ms p95=48ms throughput=1200 tok/s
Cutlass (cold): p50=20ms p95=51ms throughput=1100 tok/s

Triton  (warm): p50=12ms p95=42ms throughput=9000 tok/s
Cutlass (warm): p50=11ms p95=38ms throughput=10050 tok/s

notes: kernel_choice switched to Triton after probe threshold 3 samples; observed KV warmup at ~6th request in bench.
```

lina: telemetry shows kernel_choice_flip_count spikes right around the KV warmup window. SM util for Triton runs ~68% vs Cutlass ~82% when warm. looks like Triton's kernel path isn't leveraging some matmul fusion for this seq/batch combination.

aj: idea: implement a soft-fallback / safety-net in the arbiter. keep current probe-based autotune but add two things: 1) a short hysteresis window (eg 10s) before committing a choice; 2) a performance sanity check that can trigger an immediate fallback if steady-state throughput regresses by >7% for >= N seconds.

sam: + repro command to reproduce locally (docker bench):

```bash
./bench.sh --model v2-small --seq 32 --batches 1,2,4,8 --probe 3 --warmup 20 --log perf.csv
```

also attaching the minimal probe-plan snippet we used:

```yaml
probe_plan:
  max_probes: 5
  prefer: triton
  sanity_check:
    window_secs: 15
    min_samples: 10
    throughput_drop_pct: 7
```

perf-bot: canary report: last 24h canary (us-west) shows kernel_choice default=triton on 12% of traffic, p95 increased by 3.2% while unit_cost +1.8%. no outage.

devon: I like the soft-fallback but want one more bias knob: bias towards Cutlass when KV_hit_rate > 0.6 OR when measured KV_latency < 2ms (i.e. warmed fast). that should reduce flip-flop during the warmup transient.

lina: experiment plan: roll change to 10% of traffic (us-west) with metrics to monitor: p50/p95 latency, throughput, kernel_choice_flip_count, unit_cost, gpu_sm_util. rollback triggers: p95 regresses >5% or unit_cost increases >3% sustained for 30m.

sam: I'll run the canary and push a small config PR for the arbiter defaults (hysteresis=10s, sanity window=15s, drop_pct=7). also will add a metric expose: kernel_choice_reason {probe|sanity_fallback|manual}.

aj: please add a short runbook for oncall in the PR — steps to flip off canary, where to find perf csvs, and thresholds. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: scheduled canary rollout at 2026-03-19T02:00Z (10% us-west). monitoring alerts pre-configured.

sam: thanks — will post results after 2h and 24h checkpoints.
